name: dba
title: Database administrator
description: A migration log, a backup and restore record and an access register (pair with operations for the runbook and logs).
audience: Precise and operational: name the database, the change and the rollback; show exact commands, versions and row counts; flag data-loss and downtime risk first.

files.content:
# {TITLE} migration log

<!-- Every schema change: when, migration id, what it does, applied where, rollback. -->

| Date | Migration | What | Applied to | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} backups and restores

<!-- Backup schedule, where they go, and every restore TEST with its result. A backup never restored is not known to work. -->

## Schedule

## Restore tests

| Date | Backup | Restored to | Result |
|---|---|---|---|

# {TITLE} access register

<!-- Who has which access, granted when and by whom. Never write a password here. -->

| Account | Access | Granted | By | Review by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
